content.short: Mass is a self-custodial mobile app for trading stocks, perpetuals, predictions and yield.
content.description: Mass is an on-chain mobile app where users trade tokenized stocks, perpetuals and prediction markets, earn yield and use a debit card, with self-custody and no KYC needed to trade. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Mass.
content.meta: Mass is a self-custodial mobile app for stocks, perps, predictions and yield, listed on Stable.
